processing.leadingTrim: Only consecutive exact-zero PCM16 source frames before the first nonzero source frame; retain at least 0.5 ms of source silence; convert trim to nearest output frame. No amplitude threshold.
processing.note: One common gain preserves all source down/up and key-category level differences. Short fades soften source clip boundaries; natural mechanical onset and decay remain.
